_comment: Model routing for the fireworks reviewer backend: review purpose -> model. Edit this file to re-route; no model id is hardcoded in fireworks_runner.py. Verify against the live account with: fireworks_runner.py --check-models (needs network + FIREWORKS_API_KEY; deliberately not in the local gate). contextLength must match the live value the API reports -- it is what the pre-flight size guard checks against.

correctness.why: Verified 2026-08-03 returning schema-conforming output against finding-schema.json under json_schema enforcement. 1M context absorbs a whole-branch diff plus contract and story without the size guard tripping.

hidden-failure.why: FOR NOW (Thomas, 2026-08-04): moved off glm-5p2 to split the two parallel correctness critics across model lineages. Sharing one model made correctness and hidden-failure a same-model panel -- the echo-chamber shape OPS-13 documents, where shared training distributions validate each other's hallucinations. Picked for reasoning strength at near-zero cost (GPQA-Diamond 90.1, ~1.15M output tokens/$) and a lineage distinct from both GLM and Kimi. Verified 2026-08-04 against hidden-failure-schema.json under json_schema enforcement, on a diff carrying a planted swallowed error, which it reported. Revisit once relative review quality is measurable.

approach.why: Wired 2026-08-04. Judges shape, so its context profile pushes whole changed files at HEAD plus any dependency manifest -- not just the diff. 1M context absorbs that for a branch-sized change.

lesson.why: Wired 2026-08-06 (lesson-proposals). Judges a DIAGNOSIS rather than code, so the work is causal reasoning under thin evidence — is this a cause or a restated symptom, is a competing explanation stronger, does the claim outrun one activation. Routed to a lineage distinct from the design pass (kimi-k3) on the same principle that split the two correctness critics: the party being checked here is Claude, and a checker sharing the design pass's training distribution is a weaker second head. Cost is near-zero per run and the pass fires rarely.
lesson.verify: NOT yet exercised on a real proposal — no safeguard activation has occurred since wiring. Schema conformance is asserted by tests/fireworks_runner_test.sh; live behaviour is unproven until the first activation, and OPS-28 is the branch on which it will first run.

design.why: FOR NOW (Thomas, 2026-08-04): strongest judgment served on this account (Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index ~57, #3 overall, frontier band alongside GPT-5.5; GPQA-Diamond 93.5), and design runs once per story so the cost premium is the cheapest in the loop to pay. WIRED 2026-08-04 -- /frame step 6 dispatches here. Verified the same day against design-review-schema.json under json_schema enforcement on a real sketch, returning tagged findings at the shape altitude. Measured ~48s wall clock for a small sketch; use routers/kimi-k3-fast if consult latency bites.
